pandas.DataFrame.merge

pandas 3.1.1 · DataFrame · method

Join tables by matching keys. Set how for the join type and validate to check the expected key relationship.

  • Call syntax
  • Run the example

  • Returns

Call syntax

DataFrame.merge(…) Full signature
DataFrame.merge(
    right,
    how='inner',
    on=None,
    left_on=None,
    right_on=None,
    left_index=False,
    right_index=False,
    sort=False,
    suffixes=('_x', '_y'),
    copy=…,
    indicator=False,
    validate=None,
)
